senses.gloss:
ITA-7.1.4.23 yava यव
Barley grain
Grain of Hordeum vulgare L. Often employed as a basic unit of length.

ITA-7.2.10.4 yavakṣāraḥ यवक्षारः
Alkali mainly containing potassium carbonate

ITA-5.62.3 yavaprakhyā यवप्रख्या
Skin lesions resembling barley seeds
A disorder characterized by knotted lesions; lesions located in muscle tissue; barley-shaped lesions; very hard lesions.

ITA-9.5.4 yavavakraśalākā यववक्रशलाका
Probe with a barley seed-shaped tip
An instrument with a barley seed-shaped tip.

ITA-7.1.4.22 Measure of length equal to the distance taken by a thin string to yavodaraḥ traverse the centre of one barley grain or the central thickness of the barley grain: one-eighth of 3/4 inch, i.e. 0.24 cm. यवोदरः
Length approximately equal to thickness of barley grain at its centre
